sources.sections: Resort overview; Venetian and Palazzo accommodation; entertainment; Venetian Rewards; resort-scale positioning
sources.title: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
sources.note: Primary resort overview. Describes a resort spanning The Venetian and The Palazzo with 7,167 suites plus entertainment and other resort experiences. It also presents Venetian Rewards as a cross-resort relationship connecting play, dining, shopping and other spending.

sources.sections: Suite reservation; resort fee; cancellation; check-in and check-out; early/late departure; group bookings; third-party bookings
sources.title: Las Vegas Suites - The Venetian Resort
sources.note: Hotel source distinguishes the mandatory resort fee from optional add-ons, publishes standard check-in and checkout times, states that early check-in and late checkout are availability-dependent and may carry fees, identifies some non-cancellable rates, separates third-party booking obligations from direct bookings, and routes groups of 20 or more suites to Group Sales.

sources.sections: Check-in requirements; payment and deposits; suite assignment; resort fee; additional guests; early departure; parking; Venetian Rewards parking benefits
sources.title: Hotel Terms and Conditions - The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
sources.note: Hotel terms require the coded guest, valid identification and booking credit card at check-in, distinguish deposit and incidental requirements by reservation and suite type, and state that requested suite type/location/amenities remain requests until assignment. The terms also distinguish hotel-guest and non-hotel parking charges and identify different parking benefits for higher Venetian Rewards tiers.

sources.sections: Pool access; operating hours; cabanas and daybeds; poolside dining
sources.title: The Venetian Pool Deck
sources.note: The operator explicitly states that Venetian Pool Deck access is reserved for hotel guests only. The same environment also supports separately reservable cabanas/daybeds and poolside dining, creating a boundary between general resort presence, hotel-guest eligibility and additional paid pool products.

sources.sections: Prestige access; private check-in; concierge; breakfast; cocktails; lounge locations; additional guest fees; Prestige suites
sources.title: Prestige Club Lounge - The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
sources.note: Prestige is presented as an upgraded stay relationship with exclusive lounge access, private check-in and personal concierge service plus breakfast, evening cocktails and food. Additional lounge guests carry per-person nightly charges, so an ordinary hotel stay does not establish identical Prestige entitlement.

sources.sections: Rewards membership; tiers; earning; redemption; gaming; hotel; dining; entertainment; spa; mobile app
sources.title: Venetian Rewards - The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
sources.note: Venetian Rewards spans gaming, hotel, dining, entertainment, retail and spa activity. Tier Points determine tier level and benefit eligibility while Rewards Points are redeemable, creating a loyalty relationship that crosses several resort products rather than mapping only to accommodation or casino play.

sources.sections: Diamond-tier hotel benefits; priority; suite benefits; late checkout; transport; dining; spa; entertainment; gaming
sources.title: Venetian Rewards Diamond Tier
sources.note: Diamond membership adds benefits not presented as universal resort entitlements, including suite nights, suite upgrades subject to availability, priority line access, 4 p.m. late checkout, airport transportation, dining credit, spa discount/credit and entertainment benefits. This provides a public example of loyalty status altering rights across multiple resort domains.

sources.sections: Spa access; hotel and non-hotel day passes; qualifying treatment access; age conditions; cancellation; rewards
sources.title: Canyon Ranch Spa Las Vegas - The Venetian Resort
sources.note: Canyon Ranch publishes day-pass access for both hotel and non-hotel guests with different weekday pricing. Qualifying spa services can include Aquavana thermal-suite, fitness-center and relaxation-lounge access. Full facility access carries age conditions, and Venetian Rewards points can be earned or redeemed on eligible spa and salon services.

sources.sections: Restaurant discovery; reservations; walk-ins; dress codes; age restrictions; group dining; Venetian Rewards
sources.title: Restaurants, Bars and Lounges at The Venetian Resort
sources.note: The resort dining page recommends reservations for fine-dining and celebrity-chef venues while noting that some casual venues accept walk-ins. Dress and age conditions can vary by venue, groups from 12 to 600 can use separate group-dining arrangements, and participating restaurants interact with Venetian Rewards earning and redemption.

sources.sections: TAO Beach access; hotel-guest offer; suite-key verification; availability; blackout conditions; cabana products; dress code
sources.title: TAO Beach - The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
sources.note: TAO Beach publishes a conditional hotel-guest benefit: complimentary entry for up to two guests with a valid suite key on specified days and times, subject to availability and blackout dates. This establishes that hotel-guest status can create a benefit without guaranteeing unlimited or unconditional access to every resort venue.
